recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Claim.diagnosis.packageCode for this DSTU2 issue; any future remodelling of DRG/package billing should be driven by a newer final Financial Management decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11370 asked for a consistent term for DRG, bundle, or equivalent aggregate billing/package codes in Claim. Its Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to rename drg in Diagnosis to packageCode.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-11370 was found. Commit d06f8787e65d9eb23bd903d44c86c650b2fac541 changed the historical Claim spreadsheet source from Claim.diagnosis.drg to Claim.diagnosis.packageCode and revised the text from DRG-specific wording to package billing code wording, which appears to be the original application for Claim.
additional_context: FHIR-11371 is the paired Claim correction issue for the same rename and is already represented on the combined branch. Later Published issue FHIR-29688 required diagnosisRelatedGroup at the Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit roots and removal of resource.diagnosis.packageCode. The current active Claim source reflects that later R5 decision, and Zulip discussion after R5 points implementers to Claim.diagnosisRelatedGroup for DRGs.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The original drg-to-packageCode rename was applied historically, and the intermediate packageCode child was intentionally removed by a later final work-group decision. Current source correctly carries the concept as Claim.diagnosisRelatedGroup.

related_jiras.note: Paired Claim tracker asking to rename drg in Diagnosis to packageCode; already represented on the combined branch, so no duplicate commit was published.
Published R5 decision to add root diagnosisRelatedGroup and remove resource.diagnosis.packageCode; this supersedes the current-location aspect of FHIR-11370.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification Claim tracker asking for a consistent DRG/package-code term, resolved as renaming drg in Diagnosis to packageCode.
evidence_items.learned: This is the seed request and establishes the final DSTU2 decision to check against current source and later decisions.

evidence_items.summary: Historical source commit changed Claim.diagnosis.drg to Claim.diagnosis.packageCode and revised the wording to package billing code text.
evidence_items.learned: The requested Claim rename was applied in the old spreadsheet source even without a Jira-keyed commit message.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 issue requiring diagnosisRelatedGroup 0..1 CodeableConcept at the Claim, ClaimResponse, and EOB roots and removal of resource.diagnosis.packageCode.
evidence_items.learned: Later final WG intent supersedes the diagnosis-level packageCode representation.

evidence_items.summary: Implementation commit added Claim.diagnosisRelatedGroup and removed Claim.diagnosis.packageCode.
evidence_items.learned: The current root-level Claim element is the intentional result of the later R5 decision rather than a missing application of FHIR-11370.

evidence_items.summary: Claim is active in the current build, defines root Claim.diagnosisRelatedGroup, and Claim.diagnosis has no packageCode or drg child.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative current build-scope source already carries the package/DRG concept without the obsolete diagnosis child.

evidence_items.summary: A 2023 post-R5 DRG discussion notes that Claim has Claim.diagnosisRelatedGroup, and Paul Knapp recommends using that element name for a DRG extension in earlier releases.
evidence_items.learned: Community discussion aligns with the current source and does not support reintroducing Claim.diagnosis.packageCode.

evidence_items.command: git grep -n -E '<element id="(Claim|ClaimResponse|ExplanationOfBenefit)\.diagnosis\.(drg|packageCode)"|<path value="(Claim|ClaimResponse|ExplanationOfBenefit)\.diagnosis\.(drg|packageCode)"|<packageCode>|<drg>' -- source/claim source/claimresponse source/explanationofbenefit || true; git grep -n 'diagnosisRelatedGroup' -- source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml source/explanationofbenefit/structuredefinition-ExplanationOfBenefit.xml source/claim/claim-example-institutional-rich.xml; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-11370; bun run confluence:search fts 'drg packageCode Claim diagnosis' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search fts 'diagnosisRelatedGroup Claim' --limit 10
evidence_items.summary: No current diagnosis.drg or diagnosis.packageCode elements or conflicting Confluence records were found; root diagnosisRelatedGroup elements and a Claim example were found.
evidence_items.learned: There is no remaining current-source correction needed for the seed issue.

checks: git grep found no current Claim/ClaimResponse/ExplanationOfBenefit diagnosis.drg or diagnosis.packageCode element definitions and found root diagnosisRelatedGroup definitions.
